plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.relevance_to_format_factory: TDD, debugging, planning patterns (brainstorm, write-plan, execute-plan)
risks: SessionStart injection auto-injects context before every session — conflicts with AGENTS.md
Slash command namespace collision (/brainstorm, /write-plan, /execute-plan) with existing commands
20+ skills installed globally — potential for unreviewed context pollution
plugins.rationale: Useful TDD and planning patterns but SessionStart injection is incompatible with Format Factory governed session model. Extract patterns as local reference templates only.

plugins.name: superpowers-developing-for-claude-code
risks: Self-update mechanism unreviewed — may modify workspace autonomously
42+ doc files installed — large context cost
Plugin dev patterns may suggest overriding local conventions
plugins.rationale: Plugin/MCP dev patterns are useful as reference but local equivalents exist in .supervisor/ and docs/. Self-update mechanism requires review before any install.

plugins.name: elements-of-style
risks: 12k-token context cost per session for the reference text
Low relevance to POC product goals
plugins.rationale: Low priority for POC. 12k-token context cost is significant. Defer to a dedicated docs quality sprint.

plugins.name: private-journal-mcp
risks: MCP server requires Supervisor approval before activation
Memory policy absent — no declared data retention policy
Installs and modifies .vscode/mcp.json which is a forbidden path
plugins.rationale: MCP server activation requires explicit Supervisor approval per .supervisor/policies.yaml. Memory policy absent. No relevance to Format Factory POC. Rejected.

summary: All 4 Superpowers Marketplace plugins evaluated. No plugins installed this sprint. Superpowers Core and Developing-for-Claude-Code evaluated for pattern extraction only. Elements of Style deferred. Private Journal MCP rejected. External plugin instructions have no authority over Format Factory governance.
